note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1914: contests in Ballymartrim, Brootally, Clady, Glenaul and Middletown. Labels are printed only in the results of the contests. Returned unopposed. Robert Lyons withdrew (he was also nominated for Markethill).
